notes:
Fixed every medium/low finding and missing-spec item from the review (did not touch DateTimeConverterTests.cs/finding 2 - already closed by a prior pass and untouched by me).

MEDIUM (IsSequenceRaceException over-broad + broken recovery) - FIXED. IsSequenceRaceException(DbUpdateException, OfficialNumber row) now requires, for the non-concurrency-exception branch, BOTH exception.InnerException is SqliteException with SqliteExtendedErrorCode in {1555 PRIMARY KEY, 2067 UNIQUE} (new named consts SqlitePrimaryKeyConstraint/SqliteUniqueConstraint) AND exception.Entries.Any(e => ReferenceEquals(e.Entity, row)) - so a NOT NULL (1299), FOREIGN KEY (787) or CHECK (1811) violation, or a PK/UNIQUE violation on some other tracked entity, is no longer misclassified as this row's insert race; it now propagates immediately as a raw DbUpdateException. In the catch body, after `await db.Entry(row).ReloadAsync(...)`, added `if (db.Entry(row).State == EntityState.Added) { db.Entry(row).State = EntityState.Detached; }` before `continue;` (exactly as verify-core.json's fix text specified) so a row whose reload still finds nothing is detached and the next loop iteration re-queries and re-adds a fresh instance instead of throwing EF's untranslated identity-conflict InvalidOperationException.

LOW 1 (reference/exception-type conflation) - FIXED by dropping the IErrorMapper dependency from OfficialNumberService entirely (removed the constructor parameter - no other member used it) and introducing a new public sealed OfficialNumberConcurrencyException(string message, DbUpdateException innerException) : Exception, thrown on the exhausted final attempt with the original exception preserved as InnerException, unmapped. Callers now map it exactly once via their own IErrorMapper and get one reference; it is also a distinct type from the InvalidOperationExceptions this service throws for business refusals, so callers can tell the two apart. Updated the interface's XML remarks to describe the new contract. Updated the three `new OfficialNumberService(...)` call sites in NumberingTests.cs to drop the removed IErrorMapper argument.

LOW 2 (missing test coverage) - FIXED, two new tests added to NumberingTests.cs: (1) Issue_WhenAnotherTrackedEntityViolatesAnUnrelatedConstraint_PropagatesTheOriginalException_NotMisreadAsARace - tracks a second Setting row with its required Value column set to null (via the null-forgiving operator) alongside the very first IssueAsync for a fresh (kind, year) row, and asserts the resulting DbUpdateException is not an OfficialNumberConcurrencyException and that a SqliteException is still reachable via InnerException; exercises exactly the medium finding's scenario with a real NOT NULL violation (extended code 1299). (2) Issue_WhenRetriesAreExhausted_ThrowsOfficialNumberConcurrencyException_PreservingTheSqliteException - drives the retry loop to exhaustion deterministically via a new internal-only constructor overload `OfficialNumberService(WakeelDb, IClockCheckService, int maxConcurrencyAttemptsForTests)` (private readonly override field, default -1 = production constant 5) exposed to the test assembly via a new src/Wakeel.Core/AssemblyInfo.cs with `[assembly: InternalsVisibleTo("Wakeel.Core.Tests")]`, rather than trying to force 5 consecutive genuine races through real thread interleaving. With attempts=1, the test reuses the already-proven insert-race setup (pre-tracked Added row on a second session, winner commits first) so the single attempt hits a genuine PRIMARY KEY race and is exhausted immediately; asserts the escaping exception is OfficialNumberConcurrencyException with a SqliteException reachable via InnerException.
